# DullyPDF

> AI-powered PDF form automation: convert existing PDFs into fillable templates, fill them from data, collect answers by web form or API, and add U.S. e-signatures.

DullyPDF turns raw PDFs into reusable fillable templates using AI field detection. It is built for recurring document workflows — not one-time edits or page redesign. Upload a PDF, review detected fields, clean the template in the editor, then fill it from structured data, respondent submissions, or API calls.

## Core Workflows

- [PDF to Fillable Form](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-to-fillable-form): Upload a raw PDF, detect candidate fields with AI, refine geometry and names in the editor, and save a reusable template.
- [Image, QR, PDF417 & 1D Barcode Fields](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-field-types/image-qr-barcode-fields): Add image, QR Code, PDF417, and 1D barcode helper fields to reusable PDF templates and populate them from record data.
- [Add Image Field to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-image-field-to-pdf): Add photo, logo, ID, or receipt image fields to fillable PDF templates and render uploaded PNG/JPEG content into final output.
- [Add QR Code Field to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-qr-code-field-to-pdf): Add QR Code helper fields to PDF templates and encode manual text, verification URLs, portal links, or source-field values.
- [Add PDF417 Barcode Field to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-pdf417-barcode-field-to-pdf): Add PDF417 helper fields for dense structured record data, ID-style documents, transport paperwork, and machine-readable PDF workflows.
- [Add 1D Barcode Field to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-1d-barcode-field-to-pdf): Add linear barcode helper fields for short internal IDs, asset tags, work orders, member numbers, and tracking references.
- [Add Barcode to PDF Form](https://dullypdf.com/add-barcode-to-pdf-form): Choose QR Code, PDF417, or 1D barcode helpers based on the scan job and render the generated code into final PDFs.
- [PDF417 vs QR Code for PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/pdf417-vs-qr-code-pdf-forms): Compare PDF417 for dense structured payloads against QR Code for URLs, verification links, portals, and mobile scans.
- [Generate PDF Barcodes From CSV](https://dullypdf.com/generate-pdf-barcodes-from-csv): Map CSV, database, or API values into barcode-enabled PDF templates and generate scannable final output.
- [Image Upload Fields in PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/image-upload-fields-pdf-forms): Explain and implement reusable image upload fields for photos, IDs, receipts, logos, and other variable visual content.
- [Add Code 128 Barcode to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-code-128-barcode-to-pdf): Add Code 128 style helper fields for short internal IDs, asset tags, work orders, and tracking references.
- [Work Order Barcode PDF](https://dullypdf.com/work-order-barcode-pdf): Add barcode or QR helper fields to work order PDF templates for service IDs, field lookup, and technician workflows.
- [Asset Tag Barcode PDF Form](https://dullypdf.com/asset-tag-barcode-pdf-form): Add scannable asset tag fields to inventory, inspection, maintenance, and equipment handoff PDFs.
- [QR Code Verification PDF](https://dullypdf.com/qr-code-verification-pdf): Add verification QR links to PDFs for validation pages, signing receipts, certificates, and record checks.
- [QR Code Payment Link PDF](https://dullypdf.com/qr-code-payment-link-pdf): Add payment-link QR codes to invoice PDF templates from mapped billing records.
- [QR Code Record Lookup PDF](https://dullypdf.com/qr-code-record-lookup-pdf): Add QR codes that point PDFs back to record lookup pages, portals, shipments, invoices, work orders, or case records.
- [Scannable PDF Form](https://dullypdf.com/scannable-pdf-form): Create PDF forms with QR Code, PDF417, and 1D barcode helper fields plus human-readable fallback fields.
- [PDF Photo Upload Field](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-photo-upload-field): Add reusable photo regions to PDF templates for headshots, profiles, applicant images, and badge workflows.
- [ID Photo Field PDF Form](https://dullypdf.com/id-photo-field-pdf-form): Add ID image fields to PDF forms for onboarding, identity review, credential packets, and sensitive visual-content workflows.
- [Receipt Upload Field PDF Form](https://dullypdf.com/receipt-upload-field-pdf-form): Add receipt image fields to reimbursement, expense, invoice, and audit PDF templates.
- [Search & Fill from CSV](https://dullypdf.com/fill-pdf-from-csv): Map PDF fields to CSV, Excel, JSON, or TXT schema headers, then search rows and fill the template. Data stays in the browser.
- [Fill By Link](https://dullypdf.com/fill-pdf-by-link): Publish a hosted web form for respondents to answer. Their responses fill the PDF when the owner generates it.
- [API Fill](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-fill-api): Expose a template-scoped JSON-to-PDF endpoint with auth key management, rate limiting, and schema downloads.
- [E-Sign Workflow](https://dullypdf.com/esign-ueta-pdf-workflow): Route filled PDFs into email-based signature requests with immutable record freezing under U.S. E-SIGN and UETA.
- [PDF Form Catalog](https://dullypdf.com/forms): Browse 1,807 public-domain blank PDF forms, download the source PDF, or open a form in DullyPDF for field detection, filling, API output, and signing.
- [Catalog Workflow](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-form-catalog): Use the form catalog as a starting point for reusable PDF templates instead of uploading a local blank form.
- [Fill from Images](https://dullypdf.com/usage-docs/fill-from-images): Upload photos of IDs, invoices, or scanned documents and let AI vision extract data into template fields.
- [Batch Fill](https://dullypdf.com/batch-fill-pdf-forms): Fill multiple records or entire document packets from a single data source.
- [Fillable PDF Fonts and Colors](https://dullypdf.com/fillable-pdf-fonts-colors): Set global or per-field fonts, sizes, and colors for fillable text/date fields; saved templates keep those colors on editable and flat exports.
- [AcroForm Field Appearance](https://dullypdf.com/acroform-field-appearance): Learn how `/DA`, `/DR`, `/AP`, and `/V` keep editable PDF field values and appearance inside the fields.
- [PDF Calculation Fields](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-calculation-fields): Create number inputs and calculated outputs with safe formulas, server-side precomputation, editable Adobe compatibility, and flat final-record output.
- [PDF Calculations Not Working](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-form-calculations-not-working): Troubleshoot calculated PDF fields that work in Acrobat but fail in Chrome, Preview, mobile, or email-preview viewers.
- [Add Calculated Field to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/add-calculated-field-to-pdf): Add number inputs and read-only calculated outputs to existing PDF forms without writing Acrobat JavaScript.
- [Fillable PDF Total Field](https://dullypdf.com/fillable-pdf-total-field): Build subtotal, tax, discount, shipping, deposit, balance, and grand-total fields into reusable PDF templates.
- [API Fill Calculated PDF](https://dullypdf.com/api-fill-calculated-pdf): Send JSON source values to a saved template and let DullyPDF compute calculated outputs server-side.
- [PDF JavaScript Calculation Alternative](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-form-javascript-calculation-alternative): Use safe DullyPDF formulas instead of maintaining arbitrary Acrobat JavaScript calculation scripts.
- [PDF Calculation Order](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-calculation-order): Understand dependent calculated fields, cycle prevention, and editable PDF calculation order.
- [Invoice Calculation Template](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-invoice-calculation-template): Create invoice PDF templates with line totals, subtotal, tax, amount paid, and balance due.
- [Order Form Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-order-form-calculations): Build order-form PDFs with quantity, price, shipping, tax, discount, and grand-total calculations.
- [Estimate and Quote Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-estimate-quote-calculations): Create estimate and quote PDFs with labor, materials, markup, discounts, deposits, totals, and balances.
- [Calculated PDF From CSV](https://dullypdf.com/calculated-pdf-from-csv): Fill source number inputs from CSV or Excel rows and let DullyPDF compute read-only calculated outputs.
- [Fill By Link Calculated PDF](https://dullypdf.com/fill-by-link-calculated-pdf): Collect source number values by hosted web form and generate calculated PDFs after submission.
- [Flat vs Editable Calculated PDF](https://dullypdf.com/flat-vs-editable-calculated-pdf): Choose editable output for Adobe-first live field work or flat output for stable calculated final records.
- [Expense Report Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-expense-report-calculations): Generate reimbursement PDFs with calculated expense totals, mileage, advances, and adjustments.
- [Timesheet Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-timesheet-calculations): Build numeric-hour timesheet PDFs with calculated rate totals while keeping date/time math outside DullyPDF.
- [Purchase Order Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-purchase-order-calculations): Create purchase order PDFs with calculated line totals, subtotal, tax, shipping, discounts, and grand totals.
- [Construction Bid Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-construction-bid-calculations): Build contractor bid PDFs with calculated labor, materials, markup, deposits, and totals.
- [Change Order Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-change-order-calculations): Create change order PDFs with added costs, credits, revised totals, and signing-ready flat output.
- [Mileage Reimbursement Calculation](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-mileage-reimbursement-calculation): Calculate mileage reimbursement PDFs from miles, rate, tolls, parking, advances, and adjustments.
- [Inspection Score Calculations](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-inspection-score-calculations): Create inspection and audit PDFs with numeric score inputs, deductions, weighted sections, and final scores.
- [AI PDF Field Renaming](https://dullypdf.com/ai-pdf-field-renaming): Use AI to clean PDF field names, map schema headers, and review checkbox/radio behavior before repeat filling.
- [Fill PDF From Image](https://dullypdf.com/fill-pdf-from-image): Extract values from photos, IDs, invoices, receipts, and scanned documents into reviewed PDF templates.
- [Reusable PDF Templates](https://dullypdf.com/save-reusable-pdf-template): Save reviewed field metadata, mappings, appearance, fill rules, and editor snapshots for repeat workflows.
- [PDF Packet Workflow](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-packet-workflow): Group saved PDF templates into repeat packets for shared records, merged links, and group API ZIP output.
- [Merge Fillable PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/merge-fillable-pdf-forms): Insert pages from another PDF, reorder, delete, rotate, and review fields before saving one combined DullyPDF template.
- [Reorder Fillable PDF Pages](https://dullypdf.com/reorder-fillable-pdf-pages): Move pages inside a fillable PDF with staged Manage Pages controls, keep current-page fields with their pages, and review output before reuse.
- [Rotate Fillable PDF Pages](https://dullypdf.com/rotate-fillable-pdf-pages): Rotate sideways or misoriented pages in 90-degree steps with staged Manage Pages controls, keep current-page fields with the rotated pages, and review geometry before reuse.
- [Split Fillable PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/split-fillable-pdf-forms): Download selected PDF pages as flat or editable output, or trim the active source PDF through reviewed page tools.
- [Delete Pages From Fillable PDF](https://dullypdf.com/delete-pages-from-fillable-pdf): Remove source PDF pages through Manage Pages, drop fields on deleted pages, and review the remaining template before reuse.
- [Compress Fillable PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/compress-fillable-pdf-forms): Run lossless PDF cleanup after template review, keeping pages and field geometry stable and original bytes when optimization would be larger.
- [Fill Link + Signature](https://dullypdf.com/fill-pdf-link-signature): Collect respondent answers by hosted form, materialize the filled PDF, and route the record for signature.
- [PDF Signature Audit Trail](https://dullypdf.com/pdf-signature-audit-trail): Freeze source records, retain signing evidence, and expose public verification links for completed signature workflows.
- [Flat vs Editable PDF](https://dullypdf.com/flat-vs-editable-pdf): Choose editable output for live field work or flat output for stable final records across viewers.
- [Search & Fill Review](https://dullypdf.com/search-fill-pdf-review): Select records, validate mapped PDF output, and catch fill issues before download, signing, or scale.
- [OpenAI PDF Data Boundaries](https://dullypdf.com/openai-pdf-data-privacy): Understand which DullyPDF AI actions use PDF, schema, image, or row data.
- [Mobile-Friendly Fillable PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/mobile-fillable-pdf-form): Collect mobile PDF answers in a hosted web form, skip phone PDF viewer quirks, and generate the filled PDF on the owner side.
- [Stored Fill By Link Responses](https://dullypdf.com/stored-fill-by-link-responses): Reuse stored respondent submissions as a record source for Search & Fill, packets, signing, or API materialization.

- [Verify Signed PDF Online](https://dullypdf.com/verify-signed-pdf): Public DullyPDF validation page lets recipients re-check completed signing records via a retained token URL.
- [No-Code PDF Automation](https://dullypdf.com/no-code-pdf-automation): Automate existing PDFs through detection, mapping, filling, links, API endpoints, groups, and signing.
- [Google Sheets to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/fill-pdf-from-google-sheets): Fill reviewed PDF templates from Google Sheets rows through CSV/XLSX export, Search & Fill, or API Fill.
- [Airtable to PDF Template](https://dullypdf.com/airtable-to-pdf-template): Fill existing PDF templates from Airtable records via CSV export or JSON sent to API Fill.

- [Make Webhook to PDF](https://dullypdf.com/make-webhook-to-pdf): Build a Make scenario that maps incoming records to a DullyPDF API Fill request.

- [Java PDF Fill API](https://dullypdf.com/java-fill-pdf-api): Fill existing PDFs from Java or Spring Boot with a DullyPDF API endpoint.

- [Go PDF Fill API](https://dullypdf.com/go-fill-pdf-api): Fill existing PDFs from Go services through a lightweight HTTP API call.
- [Ruby PDF Fill API](https://dullypdf.com/ruby-fill-pdf-api): Fill existing PDFs from Ruby or Rails and attach the returned PDF to app records.
- [PDF to Online Form](https://dullypdf.com/turn-pdf-into-online-form): Publish a hosted respondent form from an existing reviewed PDF template.
- [One Web Form Multiple PDFs](https://dullypdf.com/one-web-form-fill-multiple-pdfs): Collect one respondent record and fill a saved DullyPDF template group.
- [One JSON Multiple PDFs](https://dullypdf.com/one-json-fill-multiple-pdfs): Send one API payload to generate a ZIP packet from a saved template group.
- [Respondent PDF Download](https://dullypdf.com/respondent-download-filled-pdf): Let respondents download supported flat PDF copies after submitting a Fill By Link form.
- [Online Form to Signed PDF](https://dullypdf.com/online-form-to-signed-pdf): Collect answers first, materialize the filled PDF, and route the record into signing.

## Detection and Editing

- AI field detection uses the CommonForms model with confidence scoring for text, checkbox, radio, date, and signature fields.
- The visual editor supports resize, rename, reposition, type normalization, text-safe Base 14 fonts, field font sizes, field colors, checkbox group management, and radio button editing.
- OpenAI-powered Rename + Map aligns field names to schema headers automatically.

## Plans

- **Free**: 5 saved forms, 5 detect pages, 50 fillable pages, 25 Fill By Link responses/month, 1 API endpoint (250 fills/month), 25 signing requests/month.
- **Premium**: 100 saved forms, 100 detect pages, 1,000 fillable pages, 10,000 Fill By Link responses/month, 20 API endpoints (10,000 fills/month), 10,000 signing requests/month.
